messages:
incidentbot: PagerDuty page fired: *embeddings-queue-eu* — SEV2 (pd#98765). Symptoms: elevated 5xx rate + queue latency spike > 2s. Auto-escalation to eng-sre.

jack: acked. I'm oncall and taking it. Triage incoming — pulling logs and metrics now.

deepa: on standby. any immediate customer impact known?

jack: quick dashboard: error rate ~4.1% last 5m, queue length ~12k. Affected pods: embedder-worker-3 returning repeated OOMs. Starting runbook step1 (check worker health).

ops-runbook-bot: Runbook triggered: "Embeddings queue spike" -> 1) inspect worker logs 2) scale pool 3) rolling restart 4) notify eng-sre if persists. Links: https://runbooks.internal/embeddings-queue

jack: logs excerpt: `2026-03-17T12:34:15Z ERROR embedder-worker-3 java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: failed to allocate` — consistent OOM across same instance. Suspect hot-reload or recent model change.

miguel: pinging eng-sre and model team. @sara can you look into model variant rollout logs?

sara: jumping in. checking release history and model-loader traces for embedder-prod-eu.

deepa: customer impact assessment: preliminary: ~2% of embedding requests failing in EU; four customers show elevated error rates, one tier-1 flagged. Notifying CSE for outreach.

jack: scaling up pool now: `k scale deploy/embedder-prod-eu --replicas=8` — added +4 replicas to relieve queue while we investigate.

incidentbot: Action taken: scaled embedder-prod-eu to 8 replicas (requested by jack). Autoscaler events: creating pods embedder-prod-eu-8..11.

sara: found failed hot-reload attempt on embedder-worker-3 at the time of OOM. Model loader stacktrace shows memory balloon when reloading a large quantized checkpoint. Preparing rolling restart to clear state.

jack: triggering rolling restart: `k rollout restart deploy/embedder-prod-eu` — will monitor health checks and error rate. Rollback plan staged if restarts don't reduce errors.

sara: health checks coming back OK for new pods. Error rate dropping in realtime graphs.

jack: after restart, error rate down to ~0.8% and queue draining. ETA for back to baseline ~5-10m.

miguel: good. once stable we should hand off monitoring and prepare RCA. Deepa, any customer messages needed?

deepa: drafting a short PSA for affected customers (INC-2026-113). Will share draft in #support for approval.

jack: system baseline reached: last 5m error rate 0.4%, queue length < 1k. Handing off watch to rotary oncall.

oncall-rotary: acked. I will monitor dashboards for 30m and escalate if it regresses.

miguel: updating PD: incident mitigated, suspected cause: model hot-reload memory leak on embedder-worker-3. Next steps: postmortem, revert or patch model loader, and add canary checks for hot-reloads. Assign eng-sre + model infra.

sara: adding timeline, logs, and restart artifacts to the postmortem doc (link: https://docs.internal/postmortems/INC-2026-113).

deepa: customer note ready as draft. tagging CSE for send.

jack: thanks everyone — nice quick coordination. :thumbsup:
